achievements.name: Human Form
achievements.detail: Begin in Pokopia as a Ditto that has taken a human-like form.

achievements.name: First Craft
achievements.detail: Gather materials and craft a piece of furniture.

achievements.name: Learned Move
achievements.detail: Learn a move from a Pokémon you meet and use it to grow plants, break a wall, or cross the land.

achievements.name: Home Cooking
achievements.detail: Till a field, grow a crop, and cook it into a meal.

achievements.name: New Habitat
achievements.detail: Build a habitat so a Pokémon you met has a home.

achievements.name: Neighbor's Favor
achievements.detail: Finish a request from a Pokémon neighbor.

achievements.name: Own Home
achievements.detail: Build a house of your own and invite a Pokémon to visit it.

achievements.name: Day's End
achievements.detail: Sleep in your bed and let the day pass.

achievements.name: Photo Op
achievements.detail: Take a photo of your town or of a Pokémon living there.

achievements.name: New Look
achievements.detail: Change your hairstyle or your clothes.

achievements.name: Friend Visit
achievements.detail: Invite another player to visit your world.

achievements.name: Stamp Rally
achievements.detail: Collect stamps at a Pokémon Center PC and exchange them for Life Coins.
